summary.text: Eli Savit is the Democratic nominee for Michigan Attorney General and the Washtenaw County prosecuting attorney, elected in 2020. A former public school teacher, he clerked for Supreme Court Justices Sandra Day O'Connor and Ruth Bader Ginsburg and served as senior legal counsel for the City of Detroit before his election as prosecutor.

paragraphs.text: Born and raised in Ann Arbor; attended Kalamazoo College, taught 8th-grade U.S. history, then graduated from the University of Michigan Law School.
Clerked for two federal judges and then for Supreme Court Justices Sandra Day O'Connor and Ruth Bader Ginsburg.
Senior Legal Counsel for the City of Detroit, where his campaign says he oversaw the city's opioid-industry lawsuits and a right-to-literacy case on behalf of Detroit schoolchildren.
Elected Washtenaw County prosecuting attorney in 2020.
